# Modern Benchmarks integration contract

Authorized 2 November 2026. Extend the existing workspace and Benchmark Factory;
do not create a second catalog or an execution/approval bypass.

- **BENCH-MOD-01:** Benchmarks appears in modern project navigation for authorized
  Admin/RL Engineer users; former `/p/{project}/factory` bookmarks redirect here.
- **BENCH-MOD-02:** Reuse existing project-scoped factory APIs for saved profiles,
  catalog registration, deterministic ranking, gaps and exact-version suite drafts.
  Use the signed-in member's actual identity for the retained assignment field.
- **BENCH-MOD-03:** Show actual loaded Harbor task candidates and links to task/version
  and run evidence. Do not relabel these as expert-verified published benchmarks.
- **BENCH-MOD-04:** State the static synthetic matching limits, prerequisites, metadata
  status and unsupported full TaskBank/benchmark-release workflows. No model calls.
- **BENCH-MOD-05:** Verify modern navigation/bookmark behavior, retained API workflow,
  reload, role/project boundaries and production build. Keep existing tests meaningful.

The 200–500 sample targets and professor/guide verification, full benchmark release,
cross-product SME review API, remaining production controls and recruiting belong to
the separate 30-day roadmap. No real data, partnership or scientific validation is
invented. No migration or paid-model request is required for this integration.
